top_findings.title: POST /books crashes at runtime (route + DB exist, HTTP path dead)
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api_handler.erl:9 calls cowboy_req:match_params(Req0) on every request; this function does not exist in the pinned cowboy 2.10.0 (_build/default/lib/cowboy/src/cowboy_req.erl exports match_qs/2, parse_qs/1, binding/2,3, bindings/1 — no match_params) -> error:undef before any POST logic runs. Even past that, jiffy:decode(Body) (line 19) returns EJSON and the is_map guard (line 24) fails. book_api_db:create_book works and is tested (test/book_api_db_tests.erl:24), so persistence exists but the HTTP endpoint never functions.
top_findings.suggestion: Replace match_params with cowboy_req:binding(id, Req0, undefined); decode with jiffy:decode(Body, [return_maps]) and key the DB by binary keys.

top_findings.title: GET /books crashes at runtime (list route dead over HTTP)
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api_handler.erl:9 cowboy_req:match_params/1 undef crashes every request before reaching handle_books_collection_request/2. book_api_db:get_all_books works and is tested (test/book_api_db_tests.erl:41), but the HTTP list route never executes.
top_findings.suggestion: Use cowboy_req:binding/bindings for routing instead of the non-existent match_params.

top_findings.title: ?author= filter broken two ways and unreachable
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api_handler.erl:39 calls cowboy_req:query_param/2 which does not exist in cowboy 2.10 (use match_qs/2 or parse_qs/1) -> crash; line 61 compares maps:get(author, Book) (a binary from book_api_db, e.g. <<"X">>) against AuthorName (binary_to_list result, a string) with =:=, which can never be true; and both are unreachable behind the line-9 match_params undef crash.
top_findings.suggestion: Parse the query with cowboy_req:match_qs([{author,[],undefined}], Req) and compare binary-to-binary (drop the binary_to_list).

top_findings.title: GET /books/{id} crashes at runtime
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api_handler.erl:9-11 relies on cowboy_req:match_params(Req0) returning #{id := Id}; match_params is undef in cowboy 2.10 so the id branch is never taken and every /books/:id request crashes. book_api_db:get_book_by_id works and is tested (test/book_api_db_tests.erl:56,63), incl. 404 on absent id.
top_findings.suggestion: Id = cowboy_req:binding(id, Req0) to read the :id path segment.

top_findings.title: PUT /books/{id} crashes at runtime
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api_handler.erl:9 match_params undef; even if reached, jiffy:decode(Body) (line 93) returns EJSON so the is_map guard (line 98) fails. book_api_db:update_book works and is tested (test/book_api_db_tests.erl:76,82,87).
top_findings.suggestion: Fix routing (binding/2) and JSON decoding (return_maps + binary keys).
